message.reasoning_content: We need to identify the crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: falsifying customs import tax payment certificates, using them to claim tax deduction, false invoicing, tax evasion, fraud. Likely "虚开发票罪" (crime of issuing false invoices) and "骗取出口退税罪" or "骗取增值税专用发票抵扣税款罪". Under Chinese law, article 205 of Criminal Law: "非法制造、买卖发票，或者伪造、变造发票，骗取增值税专用发票抵扣税款的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金。" Also "偷税漏税罪" maybe.
